name: CEE Capital Management
decision_note: Manager of the SIH co-investment fund Fond WTEP for waste-management infrastructure projects; investment period ended Dec 2023 and the fund is divesting.

evidence.quote: The fund focused on backing waste management projects regardless of the enterprise's maturity or size.
Formed as a fixed-term investment vehicle with a projected 10-year duration, the fund launched in 2020 and completed its active investment period in December 2023.

analyst_notes: Fond WTEP, s. r. o. (IČO 52196151) is co-owned by National Development Fund II., a.s. (SIH, ESIF money) and CEE Capital Management (ORSR e3). SIH page also says the fund is in its divestment phase. Equity/quasi-equity into waste-management infrastructure projects = project strategy (E3); no new investments after 2023 (E7).
